note: Hand-written, and it is the only cassette for this command that is. The Data Center half is a real recording (history-recorded.datacenter.json, made by scripts/dc/record.sh against the local rig). Cloud could not be recorded in the session that built the command because no Cloud credential was available to it, not because a recording is impossible: the sandbox can produce one and this file should be replaced by it. Two things here are therefore belief rather than evidence, and both are the ones a constructed cassette gets quietly wrong: that Cloud serves /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/changelog as a paged bean keyed `values` rather than `histories`, and that its author object identifies by accountId. The paging shape is what the test that reads this file actually exercises: page one holds two saves and three items, so a loop advancing by rows rather than by saves would ask for startAt=3 and skip a save.
